Interface Repository<ID, E extends Entity<ID>>

Type Parameters:
ID - the entity identifier type
E - the entity type extending Entity<ID>
All Known Implementing Classes:
AbstractFileRepository, FriendshipDbRepository, FriendshipFileRepository, InMemoryRepository, UserDbRepository, UserFileRepository
public interface Repository<ID, E extends Entity<ID>>
Generic CRUD repository interface using Java 8 Optional and Stream API.

  • Method Details

    • find

      Optional<E> find(ID id)
      Finds an entity by its unique identifier.
      Parameters:
      id - the identifier of the entity, must not be null
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the entity if found, or empty if not
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided id is null

    • getAll

      Iterable<E> getAll()
      Retrieves all entities stored in the repository.
      Returns:
      an iterable collection of all entities

    • add

      Optional<E> add(E entity)
      Saves an entity in the repository.
      Parameters:
      entity - the entity to save, must not be null
      Returns:
      an empty Optional if saved successfully, or an Optional containing the existing entity
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if the entity fails validation
      IllegalArgumentException - if the entity is null

    • delete

      Optional<E> delete(ID id)
      Removes an entity by its identifier.
      Parameters:
      id - the identifier of the entity to remove, must not be null
      Returns:
      an Optional containing the removed entity, or empty if no entity had that id
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided id is null

    • update

      Optional<E> update(E entity)
      Updates an existing entity.
      Parameters:
      entity - the entity with updated values, must not be null
      Returns:
      an empty Optional if updated, or an Optional containing the entity if it does not exist
      Throws:
      ValidationException - if the entity is not valid
      IllegalArgumentException - if the entity is null

    • findAll

      default List<E> findAll(Predicate<E> filter)
      Retrieves all entities matching a given predicate condition.
      Parameters:
      filter - the predicate used to evaluate entities
      Returns:
      a list of entities satisfying the predicate
